snippet.description:
Pressure in a Gas is a fundamental concept in Class 11 Physics that explains how gas molecules exert force on container walls. This video covers the complete topic from the FBISE and PCTB curriculum for Intermediate (FSc) Part 1 students.

In this lesson, you will learn:
- What pressure means in the context of gases
- How gas molecules create pressure through kinetic motion
- The relationship between molecular speed, mass, and pressure
- Mathematical derivations and formulas for gas pressure
- Real-world applications of gas pressure principles
- Solved examples and practice problems

Pressure in gases is essential for understanding the kinetic theory of gases, which forms the foundation of thermodynamics. Whether you're preparing for your Federal Board (FBISE) exams, Punjab Board (BISE), Sindh Board, or any Pakistani examination board, mastering this topic is crucial for scoring well in Physics.

This video is designed for Class 11 (1st Year) and Class 12 (2nd Year) students following the National Curriculum of Pakistan, PCTB textbooks, and all provincial boards. The explanation uses step-by-step derivations, diagrams, and conceptual clarity to help you grasp how gas pressure works at the molecular level.

Whether you're revising for your FSc exams or need help understanding Chapter 11, this tutorial breaks down complex concepts into easy-to-understand lessons. Perfect for students in Karachi, Lahore, Rawalpindi, Peshawar, Quetta, and across Pakistan.

Don't forget to like this video, subscribe to the channel for more physics tutorials, and comment with your questions or topics you'd like us to cover next!
